name: Neural RGB-D Surface Reconstruction
definition: A method for high-quality 3D reconstruction of room-scale scenes from an RGB-D input sequence by training a multi-layer perceptron (MLP) to represent a hybrid scene consisting of a truncated signed distance field (TSDF) for geometry and a volumetric radiance field for appearance.
summary: Neural RGB-D Surface Reconstruction generates clean, watertight 3D meshes from noisy depth data by replacing NeRF's density field with a hybrid truncated signed distance field for geometry and a radiance field for appearance.
